title: A poster for Earth Day
text: Bobby, Sam and their friends are doing a project for Earth Day.
The Earth is our home. What can we do to help it?
Let's make a poster about it. Will you join me?
Will you draw or write on the poster, Sam?
I'll draw the Earth and colour it green and blue.
Now it's my turn! I'll draw some banana trees. I like bananas.
sentences: Let's make a poster about it.
I'll draw the Earth and colour it green and blue.
